terra.problem: The phone-call line asserts that Isaiah does not consult another god. The passage says he will wait for and trust the LORD, but does not state that additional fact.
The line about going to whisper at someone else assigns the whispering to the people consulting mediums. The verse says the mediums and spiritists whisper and mutter.
The explanation assigns Isaiah a motive the text does not give. Calling God the living God is also a fact from outside the passage without a reference.
The passage has not yet described light as a promise that has not come. Isaiah 9:2 says the people have seen a great light.
The text compares the people's joy to joy at harvest time. It does not say the harvest work is done or that there is plenty.
Calling the shattered yoke, bar and rod lumber assumes they are made of wood. The verse does not specify their material.
The line about the next war implies one will occur. The verse says the boots and garments will be burned; it does not predict another war.
